answer: Proposal: an onyx exchange pays agents only from a buyer’s prepaid delivery budget, never per key. Its atlas binds each shipment ID to one terrace warehouse receipt; validators audit carrier and buyer signatures, release escrow once, burn an inspection fee, and reject reused IDs. A farm can share its model, split a shipment among clones, or self-order with borrowed cash. Splitting cannot increase that buyer’s budget; self-orders return less than the deposit after fees. Each profitable extra key needs a new outside-funded shipment; without a unique verified receipt it earns nothing.
